products.name: Tax Document Chase
products.product: A focused tax preparation missing document tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent tax preparers and small seasonal tax offices
products.problem: Organizer answers, source documents, explanations, follow-up questions, uploads, and stop conditions are tracked across portal tasks and email.
products.valueProposition: Turns tax preparation missing document tracking into a visible operating queue so every open client-document request has a specific item, reason, owner, due context, and resolved or closed outcome.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets tax preparation missing document tracking software, tax preparation missing document tracking tracker, tax preparation missing document tracking template, and tax preparation missing document tracking checklist searches.

products.name: Return Review and Signature Gate
products.product: A focused tax return review and signature readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.

products.valueProposition: Turns tax return review and signature readiness into a visible operating queue so every return proceeds to filing only after the office's review, client-delivery, signature, authorization, and payment decisions are documented.
